title: Three Matching Mug Listing Photos
tests: Tests a coordinated three-image product listing set with consistent product identity across studio, lifestyle and detail views.

faults.what: Only two images were delivered; the required whole-mug listing photo on pure white is missing.
The rim-and-glaze close-up is excessively soft, leaving the rim and surface insufficiently sharp for a useful product detail photo.

judge.summary: Two separate square photos show the breakfast scene and rim close-up, but the white-background listing photo is missing and the detail image is too soft.

must_haves.item: There are three separate square images, not a single collage.
must_haves.why: There are only two separate square images.

must_haves.item: All three show the same sage-green ceramic mug with matching shape, handle and finish.
must_haves.why: The third image is missing, and the close-up does not show enough of the mug or handle to verify full shape consistency.

must_haves.item: The main listing image shows the whole mug against a pure white background.
must_haves.why: No whole-mug image on pure white was supplied.

must_haves.item: The lifestyle image places the mug naturally on a cosy breakfast table.
must_haves.why: The mug sits naturally on a warmly lit wooden table with toast and folded linens.

must_haves.item: The detail image visibly focuses on the mug's rim and glazed surface.
must_haves.why: The close-up is composed around the rim and glazed body, although its excessive softness limits its usefulness.

must_haves.item: No image contains added text, logos or watermarks.
must_haves.why: Neither supplied image contains visible text, logos or watermarks.
